problems.what: the words are fixed: 'stop' ends it, 'less' reduces the demand, 'quiet' stops the words
problems.replace: Decide on a word to use to come out (e.g. 'stop'). You may also want words to make it less demanding (e.g. 'less'), and to stop the words (e.g. 'quiet').
problems.with: 'Stop' ends the exercise, 'less' makes it less demanding, and 'quiet' stops the words.

problems.what: feel the feet; let the breath be natural
problems.replace: You can do this practice sitting up, with your eyes open, etc.
problems.with: You can do this practice sitting up, with your eyes open, feeling your feet and letting your breath be natural.

problems.what: look at one object and feel the spine (both steps)
problems.replace: Then choose an object to look at, or feel your spine, etc.
problems.with: Then choose an object to look at, and feel your spine.

problems.what: keep alert calming and inward hypnosis on different cues (not only while driving)
problems.replace: So don't use the same thing for calming yourself while driving as you do for going into inward hypnosis!
problems.with: So keep the cue you use for calming yourself while alert separate from the one for going into inward hypnosis!

problems.what: persistent unwanted responses or disorientation need qualified help
problems.replace: If you have problems not being able to stop using it or not being able to come back from it easily, get qualified help.
problems.with: If unwanted responses or disorientation keep coming back, get qualified help.
